source.title: Gravitational Waves and Gamma-Rays from a Binary Neutron Star Merger: GW170817 and GRB 170817A
source.authors: LIGO Scientific Collaboration and Virgo Collaboration, Fermi Gamma-ray Burst Monitor, and INTEGRAL
source.license_note: The paper states that original content may be reused under the Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 licence.
locators: PDF p.1 abstract: reported (+/-1.74 +/-0.05) s delay and conditional speed bound
PDF p.4: geocentric correction and 68% confidence convention for derived gamma-ray results
PDF p.6: intrinsic-emission assumptions and conditional propagation-speed interval

estimand.uncertainty_statement: The paper reports 68% confidence for derived gamma-ray results; this summary is not admitted as a scoring likelihood.

measurement_likelihood.available_summary: A central value and reported 68% uncertainty are available in the paper.
measurement_likelihood.forbidden_substitute: Do not silently replace the source timing likelihood with an independent Gaussian observation for candidate scoring.
measurement_likelihood.admission_condition: A source-owned timing likelihood or covariance product, its units, calibration and exact lineage must be hash-pinned before any map evaluation.

source_scenarios: The paper uses simultaneous emission as a conservative upper-bound scenario.
The paper also considers a 10 s intrinsic emission delay for a conservative lower-bound scenario.
The paper notes broader exotic windows reaching approximately (-100 s, 1000 s).
intrinsic_emission_lag.admission_condition: Pre-register a defensible nuisance law or a declared set-valued likelihood without choosing it from a candidate fit.

map_contract.propagation_speed_interval: Descriptive conditional source output only; do not Gaussianize or treat as a second observation.

assumptions: The downloaded bytes correspond to arXiv version 2 and the recorded SHA-256 is the source identity for this intake.
The reported 1.74 s value is the geocentric onset/merger timing estimand described by the source.
The source timing uncertainty and intrinsic emission assumptions are distinct nuisance components.
The target is retrospective and cannot earn prospective validation credit.
missing_assumptions: A locally reproducible raw timing likelihood or covariance matrix.
A pre-registered intrinsic-emission-lag nuisance distribution or accepted set-valued uncertainty rule.
A complete admitted microscopic map through all four stages.
An immutable scorer and acceptance rule.
evidence_level: T0 source-lineage and estimator-interface intake; not a model test
acceptance_condition: Only after likelihood/covariance, nuisance law, F_obs map, and all upstream map stages are hash-pinned may this packet enter a candidate-neutral finite comparison.
falsifier: If the source product cannot supply a reproducible likelihood/covariance and defensible nuisance law, this holdout remains intake-blocked and cannot be scored.
non_claims: This packet does not identify a microscopic dynamics or mobility.
It does not select a candidate, physical vacuum, Reading-H branch, or causal cone.
It does not establish Pre-A, Sector-A, C6, A13, QFT, Yang-Mills, gravity, continuum, empirical predictivity, or a mass gap.
The conditional propagation-speed interval is not an independent Gaussian datum and is not used for scoring.
next_action: Locate or obtain the source-owned timing likelihood/covariance and preregister the intrinsic-lag nuisance law; until then keep HOLD-LC-001 INTAKE_BLOCKED and do not score candidates.
